payload.name: Unbuffered SSE Chunk Processing Without Wire Boundary Tests
payload.description: Decoding and translating raw TCP/HTTP stream chunks independently in src/holon_coherence/proxy/steps/sse_tap.py (chunk.decode('utf-8', errors='ignore') passed directly to translate_openai_sse_chunk_to_gemini) without a stateful incremental UTF-8 decoder and line-framing buffer across chunk boundaries silently corrupts multi-byte characters or drops split 'data:' JSON frames, while single-chunk unit tests mask the defect until real fragmented wire traffic hits the proxy.
payload.action: Maintain a stateful incremental UTF-8 decoder and partial-line SSE framing buffer per flow in src/holon_coherence/proxy/steps/sse_tap.py and SSE parsers while enforcing the _MAX_SSE_BUFFER_BYTES cap, flush remaining buffered lines cleanly on stream end, and add wire-level chunk-split tests (splitting mid-JSON, mid-'data:' prefix, and mid-UTF-8 codepoint) in tests/test_mitm_addon_sse.py.
symptoms: Streaming responses pass single-chunk unit tests but fail JSON parsing or drop final usage/token frames under live fragmented SSE streams.
Multi-byte UTF-8 characters split across TCP chunk boundaries are silently dropped by per-chunk decode('utf-8', errors='ignore').
Bridged Gemini SSE translation emits truncated or malformed 'data:' events when upstream OpenAI chunks split mid-line.
Unbounded SSE tap accumulation risks excessive memory growth if _MAX_SSE_BUFFER_BYTES is bypassed or omitted.
